title: System Tester
_note: Tasks from eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2519), fetched 21 Oct 2026. Questions are ours; each cites the task it was built from.

questions.text: Tell us about a time you designed test cases for a feature. How did you decide what to test first?
questions.source: eMASCO 2519, task 1: Membangunkan dan mendokumentasikan rancangan pengujian perisian.
questions.demoAnswer: In my Quality Assurance & Control project, our team built a checkout form for a small online shop, and I was in charge of testing it. I listed every field first, then used boundary value analysis on the quantity and postcode fields. That gave me 14 test cases. I started with the quantity field because a wrong value there changes the price. I also ran an integration test to check the quantity field rejects 0 and 100.

questions.text: Describe a bug you found and how you explained it to the person who wrote the code.
questions.source: eMASCO 2519, task 4: Melaksanakan, menganalisis dan mendokumentasikan keputusan pengujian aplikasi perisian serta ujian sistem maklumat dan telekomunikasi.

questions.text: How would you check that a program does what its requirements say it should?
questions.source: eMASCO 2519, task 3: Mengesahkan bahawa fungsi atur cara adalah mengikut keperluan pengguna dan garis panduan yang ditetapkan.
